source.rationale: The other side of hand-picker-families-outlive-roster, and the reason the carry is safe. The family may only outlive its roster while the customer is still PINNED to one of its members - a turn that names no customer at all has nothing for the family to scope, and keeping it would let a stale account set widen a later lookup nobody asked to widen. The first attempt at this carry was reverted for exactly that class of leak (a different company's customer sharing debtor code 300-D059 rode into scope). Same session state as the fixture above, same expired roster; the ONLY difference is that this turn's entities carry no customer uuid, and the family must be gone.
